review:
Nolimit's biggest cap: 200,000x. The 5x4 grid has locked Enhancer Cells above and below each reel, which reveal premium symbols, wilds and other features when they open.

Split Wilds can land on any reel and split every regular symbol on it, and one or two bonus symbols in the base game turn wild and open cells. Rated Insane volatility – treat it as a lottery ticket, and stick to the demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
